answer: At an inlet freight market, agents reporting gale damage receive voting weight only for tokens locked in escrow until the round ends. The ledger assigns each locked token to one voting key and gives no signup bonus. An ivory-colored dashboard shows total locked weight: splitting 100 tokens among 1,000 aliases still yields 100 votes. Extra influence requires more capital, and the withdrawal delay prevents recycling it within the round. Wealthy attackers remain a risk.
